name: Petroil
look: a tar-black slug hauling a rusty barrel like a shell, its edges burning with a glowing oil-slick rainbow, with a Trubbish riding in the barrel and another trailing behind
entry: It hauls an old barrel on its back like a shell, and a band of Trubbish rides along with it wherever it goes. The oil it leaks catches fire at the slightest spark.
how: Use a Garbage Bag (a rare drop from Garbodor) on a CobbleEffortian Slugma.
Wild: rarely, leading a band of Trubbish, at tar pits (CobbleEffort: Kanto) and near lava in badlands.
